item.title: Brendan Case
item.description:
Brendan Case

Associate Director for Research, Human Flourishing Program

Email: brendan_case@fas.harvard.edu

Dr. Case’s research bridges the humanities and social sciences to explore the nature, distribution, and determinants of a flourishing life, with a particular focus on dispositions such as love, and on key institutional pathways to flourishing, such as religious communities and marriage.

item.title: Cameron Harvey
item.description:
Cameron Harvey

IT Client Support Services Associate

Email: help@iq.harvard.edu

Cameron Harvey joined IQSS in 2018 as an IT Client Services Support Specialist. He provides members of the IQSS community with IT desktop support. Previosly Cameron worked in the role of IT Systems Administrator for an EMS service provider, as well as IT Systems Support for a medical firm.

item.title: Cheng Shi
item.description:
Cheng Shi

Front-End Developer, Dataverse

Email: cshi1@g.harvard.edu

Cheng Shi graduated from the University of Southern California in 2023 with a master’s degree in Data Science, following her bachelor’s degree from Penn State University. She currently serves as a front-end developer for Dataverse at IQSS. In this role, she develops high-performing single-page applications, ensuring optimal user experiences through efficiency and precision. Her interests extend to broader web application development, where she continues to explore innovative solutions to enhance functionality and user engagement.

item.title: Dan Yuan
item.description:
Dan Yuan

Data Science Project Management Specialist

Email: tyuan1@fas.harvard.edu

Dan Yuan serves as a Data Science Project Management Specialist at IQSS, coordinating and managing data science projects and providing technical support to researchers across the institute.

item.title: Danny Ebanks
item.description:
Danny Ebanks

Research Associate

Email: debanks@g.harvard.edu

Danny recently earned his PhD at Caltech in Quantitative Social Sciences, where he developed his research interests in Political Methodology, American Politics and Congress. His research focuses on latent variable models, Bayesian statistics, legislatures, and natural language processing. At IQSS, he strives to develop and implement statistical methods, to understand the latest in machine learning and AI, and innovate in these areas in ways small and large to better understand our political world. He is always eager to chat about research and statistics, so feel free to reach out. Outside of research, he is a lifelong runner who hails from New York.

item.title: Don Sizemore, II
item.description:
Don Sizemore, II

Developer, Dataverse; Systems Programmer, UNC

Email: don.sizemore@gmail.com

Don Sizemore became involved with IQSS through the Dataverse project when he joined the Odum Institute in 2015. He is the primary author of the Dataverse-Ansible role, a consultant through the Global Dataverse Community Consortium, and attempts to support the Dataverse community over its various communication channels. He holds a Master of Information Science from UNC’s School of Information and Library Science, but highly cherishes his undergraduate minor in music performance on pipe organ.

item.title: Dwayne Liburd
item.description:
Dwayne Liburd

Library Assistant, Data Science

Email: dliburd@hmdc.harvard.edu

Dwayne Liburd is the Data Technology Support Associate in Data Acquisition and Archiving. His responsibilities include assisting the Manager of Data Acquisition, providing assistance on using Dataverse services, and providing user support for Dataverse. Dwayne also maintains the Henry A. Murray Research Archive Dataverse. He performs the cataloging of the metadata, storage of data related to the archive, and data processing, preservation, and dissemination of the original holdings of the Archive.

item.title: Ellen Kraffmiller
item.description:
Ellen Kraffmiller

Principal Software Architect and Data Engineer

Email: ekraffmiller@hmdc.harvard.edu

Ellen Kraffmiller is a software engineer who has been at IQSS for over ten years. Previously, she worked in software consulting, financial services and biotech industries. She has contributed to the Dataverse and Consilience projects. She has expertise in distributed computing, machine learning and natural language processing.

item.title: Emily Lawrence
item.description:
Emily Lawrence

Linux Systems Administrator, HMDC

Email: elawrence@hmdc.harvard.edu

Emily majored in Electronic Media, Arts and Communications at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, and worked at BU for six years before joining IQSS in 2016.

item.title: Emma Loayza
item.description:
Emma Loayza

Office Manager

Email: egloayza@iq.harvard.edu

Emma joined IQSS in May of 2024. Prior to that, she worked as an Office Manager in both the Library Student Employment Program and the Digital Ventures Lab at Boston University Libraries. Her current work at IQSS focuses on physical space management, as well as assisting with a variety of projects for the IQSS Operations team. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Archaeology from Boston University, and enjoys reading, writing, and cooking in her free time.

item.title: Evan Sarmiento
item.description:
Evan Sarmiento

Front End Systems Software Developer

Evan Sarmiento is a Front End Systems Software Developer at IQSS, specializing in user interface development and front-end technologies for the institute’s various research and data management platforms.

item.title: Farhan Ghrairi
item.description:
Farhan Ghrairi

Assistant Director of Finance

Farhan Ghrairi serves as the Assistant Director of Finance at IQSS, overseeing financial operations and providing strategic financial leadership for the institute.

item.title: Gabrielle Stone
item.description:
Gabrielle Stone

Events Coordinator

Email: gstone@iq.harvard.edu

Gabrielle is a professional event planner who has worked with Harvard University for 10 years. She graduated from the University of Connecticut with a Bachelor’s degree in English and has a Certificate of Special Studies in Administration and Management from Harvard Extension School, focusing on nonprofit management, marketing and public relations, museum administration, and fundraising. Her previous career was in publishing.

item.title: Gustavo Durand
item.description:
Gustavo Durand

Dataverse Technical Lead / Architect

Email: gdurand@iq.harvard.edu

Gustavo Durand is the Technical Lead and Architect of Dataverse, an open source data repository platform developed by IQSS at Harvard University. Gustavo has been on Dataverse in many roles since its inception and in his current role, leads the architecture and technical design of the platform, reviews code from internal and and external developers, assists the Dataverse Community contributors, and overall works closely with the Development Project Manager. He began his Java programming career at Cambridge Technology Partners in 1997 and has over 20 total years experience as a software developer and consultant.

item.title: James D Myers
item.description:
James D Myers

Developer, Dataverse Core Development Team

Email: jim.myers@computer.org

Dr. Myers is an independent software architect, designer, and developer currently working in the Dataverse community through the Global Dataverse Community Consortium (GDCC) and the Qualitative Data Repository (QDR). He received his B.A. in Physics from Cornell University (1985) and his Ph.D. in Chemistry from the University of California at Berkeley (1993). He has more than three decades of experience in the development and deployment of Cyberinfrastructure for research, education, and industrial application and has participated in the planning and execution of multiple large community cyberinfrastructure projects for the US NSF, ONR, and DOE. Dr. Myers has been active in the development of provenance and content management standards and has led efforts to design and develop data-intensive hardware and software systems. As a co-PI on SEAD DataNet project, Dr. Myers helped develop a scalable mechanism for the long-term preservation of scientific research results based on semantic web and cloud technologies and leveraging active and social curation approaches to increase data re-use and lower lifecycle costs. He has development experience using multiple languages (Java, Scala, PHP, Javascript, C/C++) and technologies (including relational and document databases, semantic web, preservation formats, dev/Ops, Docker, AWS).

item.title: Jeffrey Blossom
item.description:
Jeffrey Blossom

GIS Service Manager, Center for Geographic Analysis

Jeffrey Blossom is the GIS Service Manager at the Center for Geographic Analysis (CGA). He provides expert guidance and support to researchers utilizing geographic information systems and spatial analysis methodologies in their work.

item.title: Jinjie Liu
item.description:
Jinjie Liu

Data Science Specialist

Email: jinjie_liu@fas.harvard.edu

Jinjie works as a Data Science Specialist on the Data Science Services team at IQSS. She holds a master’s degree in Economics from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, and a PhD in Political Science from the University of Wisconsin-Madison. She further finishes her master’s study in Computer Science from Cleveland State University. Jinjie is interested in formal modeling, statistical modeling, machine learning, data manipulation and management as well as political economy and comparative research methods. She has experience in statistical programs including Stata and SPSS. She also has experience with general-purpose programing languages including Python, C/C++, SQL, Java, Matlab.

item.title: Jorge Dasilva
item.description:
Jorge Dasilva

Senior Sponsored Research Administrator

Email: jdasilva@iq.harvard.edu

Jorge joined the Sponsored Finance team at IQSS in July 2023 as a Sr. Sponsored Research Administrator. He supports several principal investigators affiliated with IQSS. He is described as “a seasoned finance professional with over 25 years of experience in both education and the business sector.” Jorge joined Harvard in 2003 as a Grants Manager at the New England Primate Research Center and subsequently held roles with the Department of Psychology and the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. In these positions he “managed complex financial reporting and analysis, lead business operations initiatives and assisted faculty and staff with portfolio management.” He lives with his wife and 3 children (15-year-old boy/girl twins and 14-year-old son) and in his spare time enjoys spending time on his boat and attending his children’s sporting activities.

item.title: Joshua Cetron
item.description:
Joshua Cetron

Data Science Specialist

Email: jcetron@iq.harvard.edu

Josh is a data scientist, social scientist, and methodologist with a background in psychology, neuroscience, and multivariate statistics. As a Data Science Specialist at IQSS, he provides methods and analysis consulting services and collaborative support to Harvard-affiliate researchers across the sciences, focusing on experimental methods, exploratory analysis, and regression modeling of empirical data in R and python. He joined IQSS in June 2023 after completing his Ph.D. in Psychology at Harvard, where he studied psychological and neural representations of social and political information, including political propositional knowledge and social group attitudes. During graduate school, he developed an interest in methods and analysis development and support as a Teaching Fellow for multiple graduate-level statistics courses, teaching advanced statistical methods and collaborating with statisticians to develop new analytical methods. Prior to his Ph.D., he completed his B.A. in neuroscience at Dartmouth College, where he studied neural representations of concept knowledge acquired through classroom-based learning. Outside of work, he enjoys playing music, rock climbing, and exploring coffee shops in Somerville and Cambridge.

item.title: Juan Pablo Tosca
item.description:
Juan Pablo Tosca

Senior Software Developer, Dataverse

Email: juan_tosca@iq.harvard.edu

Juan Pablo Tosca is a Senior Software Developer who joined IQSS in 2023 to work on the Dataverse project. He previously worked at the Harvard Graduate School of Education as a Senior Software Developer focused on Java and Spring applications. He became involved with Dataverse and the Containerization Working Group before officially joining the team, and has contributed to Dataverse releases since version 6.1. He is originally from Xochimilco (meaning “place of the flowers” in Nahuatl) in Mexico City, and came to the United States in 2014 after completing his MBA at Universidad del Valle de Mexico. He is fluent in English and Spanish. In his free time, he enjoys discussing immigration, music, and technology.

item.title: Julian Gautier
item.description:
Julian Gautier

Product Research Specialist

Email: juliangautier@g.harvard.edu

Julian Gautier joined IQSS in September 2016 as a product research specialist for the Data Science and Product Research team, responsible for providing and extending Dataverse metadata support, and helping collect software requirements from product leaders and its community of users. Shortly before joining the team, Julian finished a Masters program in Library and Information Science at UCLA, studying and practicing user experience research and information architecture. His interests outside of work include volunteering in UX communities and playing basketball and tennis.

item.title: Junyi Chen
item.description:
Junyi Chen

GIS Analyst, Center for Geographic Analysis

Email: junyichen@fas.harvard.edu

Junyi Chen is a master’s student in Machine Learning and Data Science at Northwestern University, beginning her studies in fall 2024. She graduated Cum Laude from Stony Brook University in December 2021, earning dual bachelor’s degrees in mathematics & applied mathematics and statistics, which she completed in 2.5 years. She also minored in computer science and participated in the WISE (Women in STEM) honors program. After graduation, Junyi worked as a full-time data analyst at Transwarp Technology in China for two years, focusing on the supply chain and finance fields. She is also certified as a Data Management Professional Associate and has developed a strong interest in big data and spatial data analysis. Driven by a passion for using data to drive industry growth and research advancements, she has contributed remotely to multiple CGA projects and is looking forward to expanding her work in geospatial analysis with the IQSS.

item.title: Keri Lemasters
item.description:
Keri Lemasters

Senior Sponsored Research Administrator

Email: klemasters@iq.harvard.edu

Keri joined the sponsored finance team at IQSS in February of 2019 and has worked in sponsored administration for nine years. She supports several principal investigators affiliated with IQSS in pre-award and post-award services for federal and private foundation awards. Prior to IQSS, she worked for five years as a Financial Analyst with the Office for Sponsored Programs at Harvard. At OSP, she was a key contributor in managing the Financial Reporting Application Portal (FRAP), which “drastically increased monthly automation of financial reports and invoices to over 60%.” In 2016, she assisted HUIT/FSS with the FIRST project, which successfully transitioned FRAP automation into GMAS in April 2018, enabling new applications for sponsored compliance and financial reporting (Transaction monitoring and Financial Dashboard). She also contributed to university-wide financial award set up and revisions of thousands of funded projects feeding into Harvard’s peripheral financial systems. She “was nominated as a Harvard Hero for remarkable sacrifice for co-workers, departments, and the University in 2015.” She holds a Bachelor of Arts in Interdisciplinary Humanities from Michigan State University.

item.title: Leonid Andreev
item.description:
Leonid Andreev

Senior Developer, Dataverse Project

Leonid Andreev is a Senior Developer on the Dataverse Project at IQSS. He brings extensive expertise in software development and has been instrumental in advancing the Dataverse platform, an open-source data repository software used by research institutions worldwide.

item.title: Linda Christlieb
item.description:
Linda Christlieb

Finance Associate

Email: lchristlieb@iq.harvard.edu

Linda has been with Harvard University since 2012. Prior to joining IQSS in 2015 in the Finance and Administration Division, Linda worked as a Faculty Assistant and Executive Assistant for an economics professor for three years. Her current responsibilities include payroll, processing payments and reimbursements and many other finance transactions for IQSS and it’s affiliates. Linda holds a Bachelor’s degree from Southern Connecticut State University and has two sons in college.

item.title: Lisa Galvin
item.description:
Lisa Galvin

Academic Affairs Coordinator

Email: lgalvin@iq.harvard.edu

Lisa joined IQSS in November 2011. Prior to this, Lisa worked as a temporary Human Resources Coordinator in Harvard’s Faculty of Arts and Sciences (FAS) HR department. Lisa earned her Professional in Human Resources (PHR) certification in June 2013 and also holds a Bachelor’s degree. She enjoys reading, television, movies, music, and keeping up with current events. Lisa lives with her husband in Cambridge.

item.title: Liz Salazar
item.description:
Liz Salazar

Communications Coordinator

Email: lsalazar@iq.harvard.edu

Liz Salazar has been at IQSS since 2010, working her way into her current role via management of the IQSS website and social media. As Communications Coordinator, she oversees the Institute’s online presence, publicity, and external communications, plus updates to the IQSS affiliate database. She previously worked at the Harvard Foundation (part of Harvard College Student Life), and before Harvard she was at Boston University’s Center for English Language.

item.title: Maria Martins
item.description:
Maria Martins

Executive Assistant

Email: mmartins@iq.harvard.edu

Maria joined IQSS in March 2016. She previously served as an Executive Assistant in Harvard’s Office for Sponsored Programs (OSP) for eight years. Before Harvard, she worked at The Inn at Harvard as Office Manager and at the Hilton Back Bay and Hilton Logan Airport as a Sales and Catering Assistant. She holds a “Bachelors of Science in Business Administration from Newbury College.” In her free time, she “enjoys spending time with her family, running, and volunteering.”

item.title: Michael O'Brien
item.description:
Michael O’Brien

Academic Affairs Coordinator

Email: mobrien@iq.harvard.edu

Michael joined IQSS in May 2024 as an Academic Affairs & HR Coordinator, having previously served as interim Office Manager in the IQSS’ Business Operations Division. He provides academic personnel and staff support for all IQSS faculty affiliates across the University, focusing on academic policy advisement, classification and compensation, recruitment, Visa administration, leaves administration, and general HR policies. His prior experience includes public health consultancy at John Snow Inc., healthcare administration at Boston Children’s Hospital, and operations at BXP. He “graduated summa cum laude from the University of Massachusetts Boston” with a BA in Sociology.

item.title: Mike Reekie
item.description:
Mike Reekie

Senior Project Manager for Engineering

Email: mreekie@iq.harvard.edu

Mike Reekie is the Senior Project Manager for Engineering and Technical Operations at IQSS, Harvard. He handles day-to-day project management for the IT Operations team and Engineering software development projects for the DevOps team.

His background includes serving as Director of Systems Engineering at Momentum Telecom, where his team modernized and scaled nationwide infrastructure supporting data-over-cable and wholesale VoIP networks, managing provisioning for 900K cable modems for 300 independent cable ISPs.

item.title: Noah Greifer
item.description:
Noah Greifer

Data Science Specialist

Email: ngreifer@iq.harvard.edu

Noah Greifer has been a member of the Data Science Services team at IQSS since August 2021. He earned his BS in Psychology from UC San Diego, worked in the Office of Institutional Research at Reed College, and earned his MA and PhD in Quantitative Psychology at UNC Chapel Hill before a brief post-doc in the Department of Mental Health at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. He specializes in causal inference methods for observational studies, including propensity score matching and weighting methods, and has written or maintains several R packages designed to implement these methods, including ‘WeightIt’, ‘MatchIt’, ‘cobalt’, and ‘MatchThem’, among others. He loves mint chip ice cream, new music, and sudoku.

item.title: Philip Durbin
item.description:
Philip Durbin

Software Developer, Dataverse Project

Email: philip_durbin@harvard.edu

Phil Durbin holds a Psychology degree from the University of Dayton and works as a Software Developer on the Dataverse Project at IQSS. He was part of the team that rewrote Dataverse to be more inclusive of all science. He is enthusiastic about the growth of Dataverse installations to over a hundred, and actively participates in the community through the mailing list, chat room, and monthly community calls. He sends out the monthly Dataverse Community News and looks forward to the annual Dataverse Community Meeting. He is passionate about open source (having given a talk at JavaOne about running an open source project) and created a dataset called “Open Source at Harvard” in Harvard Dataverse. He co-founded the codecraft mailing list, has a project called Crossroads, and makes mobile games with his kids. He blogs at blogs.harvard.edu/pdurbin and his personal website is greptilian.com.

item.title: Rand Kiessig
item.description:
Rand Kiessig

Manager, IQSS Computer Lab Services

Email: rkiessig@iq.harvard.edu

Rand Kiessig joined IQSS in May 2012 and has led IQSS Computer Lab Services since 2015. A California native, Rand has lived across the U.S. — from Washington State to North Carolina to Massachusetts — with stints in Mexico and Spain along the way. Before coming to Harvard, he held a range of technical roles at organizations including Microsoft, Verio, Data General, and Iron Mountain.

item.title: Robert Treacy
item.description:
Robert Treacy

Principal Software Architect, Dataverse

Email: rtreacy@hmdc.harvard.edu

Bob Treacy is a Principal Software Architect and Data Engineer. He came to IQSS in 2006 at the beginning stages of the Dataverse Project and participated in the initial architecture, design and development of the system. He worked on a project for survey research, the Consilience project for text analysis, differential privacy, and maintained the Zelig project and various other R packages when they were hosted on CRAN. He has been working with Java since 1995, when he was at Fusion Systems Group, a consulting firm which worked closely with Sun Microsystems. He has over 35 years in software development for manufacturing, financial systems, education course management, news delivery and various web companies. In addition to Java, he has developed in Scala, C/C++, Python, and R. He has worked with various relational databases and NoSQL databases. His first distributed systems project in the early 90s involved integrating stove-piped legacy terminal-based manufacturing systems using modern UIs and in recent years has worked with Hadoop and Spark for machine learning and AI. He is currently involved with fine-tuning local Large Language Models using FAS RC on Dataverse data. He has worked with the AWS and Azure cloud platforms.

item.title: Roy Guyton
item.description:
Roy Guyton

IT Client Support Services Associate

Email: rguyton@hmdc.harvard.edu

Roy is a graduate of Willamette University where he received a BA in Spanish Literature and International Studies in Salem, OR. He also received his Ed.M for Technology in Education from the Harvard Graduate School of Education. Additionally, Roy has taken graduate courses at NIH, MIT and the Division of Continuing Education (DCE) at Harvard University. Roy was employed with the Harvard Graduate School of Education for 12 years where he ran the student help desk, and employed 10 years at DCE as a graduate teaching assistant. He spent three years in Costa Rica as a US Peace Corps volunteer working with IBM, MIT, Omar Dengo Foundation and the Costa Rican Department of Education on a national computer education program. He holds extensive contracting experience since 1992 in the area of technology in education. Roy was also a board member of several non profit organizations.

item.title: Sarah Duncan
item.description:
Sarah Duncan

IT Operations Manager, IQSS/Harvard-MIT Data Center

Email: slduncan@fas.harvard.edu

Sarah Duncan is the IT Operations Manager at IQSS/Harvard-MIT Data Center. She supports Social Science research using Linux and holds an undergraduate degree in Engineering and Applied Science and a Masters in Divinity, both from Harvard. Previously, she served as webweaver for Harvard’s Department of Genetics at the Medical School, spent eleven and a half years handling IT for the Harrison/Wiley x-ray crystallography labs in Biochemistry, and most recently worked eight years at WGBH as a UNIX, Storage, and Windows Systems Administrator. She lives in Boston’s North End with her wife Reay and two cats, speaks Spanish and Tamil (learned during a college year abroad in Madurai, India), and enjoys reading, learning new things, travel, cooking, yoga, crafts, and glass bead making and fusing.

item.title: Soner Taskaya
item.description:
Soner Taskaya

Associate Director of IT Client Services

Email: staskaya@iq.harvard.edu

Soner Taskaya is Associate Director, IT Client Services at IQSS. He joined HMDC/IQSS as an IT Support Specialist in August 2003. Previously, he served as a Junior Systems Administrator at a startup software company for four years and worked in IT support at Harvard Medical School as a Client Support Representative for two years. He earned his B.A. in Business Management and Marketing from Curry College. In his free time, he enjoys traveling, hiking with his dog, snowboarding in winter, and golfing and fishing in summer.

item.title: Sonia Barbosa
item.description:
Sonia Barbosa

Associate Director of Dataverse Support, Data Curation, and Murray Archive

Email: sbarbosa@hmdc.harvard.edu

Sonia Barbosa is the Associate Director of Dataverse Support, Data Curation, and the Murray Archive. Her responsibilities include developing and promoting the use and benefits of the Dataverse Software and outreach and acquisitions of data for the Harvard Dataverse Repository. Sonia leads training on data curation and consults with users on organizing, cleaning, and preparing data for sharing and preservation, and provides curation support and guidance for users of the tool. Sonia also manages the data housed at the Murray Archive, a human subjects social science data archive housing longitudinal data on the lives of women. She is responsible for curation of the collection, preservation of data related to the archive, and data processing and dissemination. Sonia works closely with the Dataverse development team to increase awareness of the needs of the research community and provides usability feedback on the Dataverse features. She has over 27 years of data curation and management experience in the social sciences. She holds a BA in Psychology with a concentration in African American Studies from the College of the Holy Cross, 1995, and a BSN from Simmons College, 2009.

item.title: Stephen Kraffmiller
item.description:
Stephen Kraffmiller

Software Developer, Dataverse Project

Email: skraffmiller@hmdc.harvard.edu

Stephen has been a developer on the Dataverse Project since 2010. He is involved in all aspects of the Dataverse project, from the front end UI development to the back end business logic. For the Dataverse project he was the lead developer for custom dataset metadata fields, persistent identifiers, guestbook and download tracking. He also implemented dataset templates and external query tools. He has given three presentations at JavaOne conferences over the years including “jQuery Integration with JSF 2 Libraries” with Mike Heppler and “Custom Bean Validation” with Gustavo Durand. Currently he is spearheading the effort to make Dataverse data available via the Google Data Commons. In his spare time he enjoys running, reading, cooking and following the career of a talented playwright who happens to be his daughter.

item.title: Steven Winship
item.description:
Steven Winship

Software Developer and Systems Administrator

Email: steven_winship@iq.harvard.edu

Steven is working on the Dataverse Project.

item.title: William Horka
item.description:
William Horka

Systems Administrator, Harvard-MIT Data Center

Email: whorka@hmdc.harvard.edu

William Horka serves as a Systems Administrator at the Harvard-MIT Data Center, providing technical support and managing computing infrastructure for social science research.

item.title: Ying Chen
item.description:
Ying Chen

Research Associate & Data Scientist, Human Flourishing Program

Ying Chen is a Research Associate and Data Scientist with the Human Flourishing Program at IQSS. She applies her expertise in data science and quantitative methods to research exploring human well-being and flourishing.
